# Example – Research Agent with CogniTree Skill

This example shows how to use CogniTree in a research/workflow agent.

## Scenario

You have an agent that performs multi-step research and needs to maintain long-term understanding.

## How to use CogniTree

1. Build a context pack at the start of each phase.
2. Move detailed notes into episodic or long-term memory after each phase.
3. Check drift after major changes in research direction.

## Result

The research agent stays focused, coherent, and easier to resume later.
